title: plugin.json v0
description: The manifest every plugin folder carries, built-in and community plugins alike.

description.description: One sentence about what the plugin does.

permissions.description: Everything the plugin may ask for. Each one is still granted by the person at first use.

imports.description: Other plugins whose files this plugin's pages load (`../../<id>/…`). Each surface has an origin of its own, so another plugin's files load on it only when named here; their code runs in this plugin's frames, as this plugin and under its grants. Libraries load everywhere without an entry (ADR 0049).

surfaces.description: Surfaces a UI plugin can open. Only UI plugins declare surfaces.

provides.description: The roles this plugin can fill (BR-05, ADR 0104): role:rail, role:agents and role:dock are the desk's three edges, role:palette the command palette, role:settings-ui the settings window. The desk.roles setting chooses each role's provider among the plugins that provide it; a provider that is not chosen does not mount that role's surfaces.

autoload.description: Installed but off until the desk needs it, like Emacs's autoload. With no stored enabled flag the plugin starts off, and its file openers count while it is off: desk.files turns it on to open a file and off again when its last file closes; profiles leave it as it is. Default false.

view.description: A view plugin's one view, inline; a pack's own view too.

views.description: A view plugin's view files, one PluginView each, relative to the plugin folder; a pack's too.

pack.description: A pack's pack block: what it brings and does when applied (ADR 0108).

theme.description: A theme plugin's theme: its layers and the font and image files it brings, relative to the plugin folder.

designSystem.description: A design-system plugin's design system: what each component of the desk is made of (ADR 0090).

PluginId.description: Reverse-domain style id with at least one dot, lowercase, for example endue.eris or example.hello-ui.

Role.description: A role a plugin fills: role: and a lowercase name.

PluginKind.description: ui runs in a sandboxed iframe, logic in a Wasm instance, tool as an MCP server inside the VM. policy runs no code: it only contributes data (ADR 0017). library runs no code of its own either: it is files other plugins import, served at /<id>/... like any plugin's, never mounted and never turned off. connector brings an app's data in as items, as a Wasm component, an MCP server or an http block the core runs (no entry; ADR 0106); view runs no code either: it is one or more views (ADR 0032). theme runs no code: it is a theme block and its font and image files, chosen with desk.theme.active (ADR 0056). design-system runs no code either: it is a designSystem block of component recipes, chosen with desk.design.active (ADR 0090). pack runs no code either: a pack block naming the plugins it brings (nested in its folder or on the desk), its own views and its contributed layout (ADR 0108).

EntryPath.description: Path to the entry file, relative to the plugin folder, without .. segments.

PluginView.description: A view a plugin provides: a universal view or a page of them (ADR 0087, ADR 0103), with its id, or an item view (ADR 0032; deprecated, read through v0).

ViewPath.description: A view file relative to the plugin folder, without .. segments: YAML (.yaml, .yml) or JSON (.json).

Surface.description: A surface a UI plugin can open on the desk.

title.description: Shown where the surface needs a label.

hidden.description: Mounted but not shown until the plugin shows it, like a palette. Default false.

SurfacePlacement.description: Where the compositor puts the surface.
